faq.q1: Is it a subscription? Will I be charged again?
faq.a1: No. The pass is paid once and works for the whole 2026/27 season — there are no automatic charges.
faq.q3: How do I get a refund?
faq.a3: Write to us within 14 days of payment and we’ll refund you through PayPro Global. Details are in “Payment and refunds.”
faq.q4: Can I give the pass as a gift?
faq.a4: Not yet: the pass belongs to whoever paid — it works on the device you paid from and attaches to the first account you sign in to here (once only).

faq.passA: A toast is your greeting to the whole world: a gold toast in the World chat; for $5, also pinned under the stream until the next midnight; for $10, your nickname in the midnight greeting and a New Year Pass as a gift. The pass unlocks features: schedule and reminders, journey map, chat badge. All streams and chat are free for everyone.

faq.checkQ: What if my toast doesn’t pass the check?

faq.londonAnswer: London and the whole UTC+0 time zone ring in the New Year at 00:00 UTC.

faq.whyQuestion: Why do some countries celebrate at a different time?
faq.whyAnswer: The world is divided into time zones, and each has its own midnight. Some countries use a non-standard offset — half an hour or 45 minutes — so their midnight doesn’t fall on the hour.

when.q: When is midnight in my time?
when.a: Midnight in this country arrives at {time} your time. The countdown runs right on the page, so you don’t need to calculate it.

stamp.q: Will I get a stamp if there’s no stream?
stamp.a: Yes. The stamp is for being on the country page at midnight, not for watching a video. A stream may appear later or not at all — the stamp will still arrive.

switch.a: In the “Streams” block, tap the card you want — the player switches to it right away. Or tap “Choose stream” under the video.

room.q: Can I watch several streams at once?
room.a: Yes, in the viewing room. Tap “+” on a stream card to add it in a new window. On a computer you get up to four windows, on a phone up to two. Sound plays from only one.
